bugs.text: entryTimer starts at 0, so the entry queue never assigns paths; the first play update throws 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 0)' at catmull2(e.path[0]...) every frame. The game freezes on the READY screen with all enemies stacked at one point (5611 errors in the play-test).
Space is never mapped to keys.space; the player can never fire.
Game over sets state='gameover' but the state machine and renderer use 'gameOver': nothing is drawn, the results screen never shows, and it never returns to the title.
Ram collision compares the player with itself (always true), so the player dies colliding with enemies[0] as soon as invulnerability ends.

The tractor beam never starts (e.beam is never set before updateBeam, which is gated on it), and the capture test player.y<e.y can never be true; capture, rescue, dual fighter and captive fire are all dead code.
The freed captive is a plain object not in enemies[], so it never flies down or docks; dockCaptive is never called.
Formation is 5x5 (5 Boss, 10 Goei, 10 Zako = 25), not 4/16/20 = 40.
Boss scoring wrong: no 150 in formation; 800 alone and 400 with one escort (swapped).
formation.active is never set true, so breathing never happens; slot y ignores the breathing scale.
Divers return by lerping up from below the screen instead of re-entering from the top.
4 ships in total (game over at ships<0), and the reserve display counts the ship in play.
Challenge fly-through enemies that leave are counted as hits, so the bonus is always PERFECT.
Stage badges draw one flag per stage with successive denominations instead of decomposing the stage number.
Dual fire adds two shots but increments player.shots once, breaking the two-shot limit bookkeeping.
A hit on either half of a dual fighter kills the whole player.

summary: The file is tidy on the surface: one self-contained page, a correct fixed-timestep rAF loop, separate update and render functions, a good title screen with a score table, a localStorage high score and Web Audio with mute. Underneath, the game cannot be played. The entry queue never starts (entryTimer is 0), so the first gameplay frame throws on a null path and every frame after it does too; the play-test froze on READY with 5611 errors. Even if that were fixed, Space is never bound so the player cannot shoot, the ram check always hits, and the misspelled 'gameover' state blanks the game-over/results screen and never returns to the title. The signature Galaga mechanics are dead code: the tractor beam never switches on, capture can never trigger, and the captive/dual-fighter path never runs. The formation is a 5x5 grid of 25 blob-shaped sprites rather than the 40-enemy arcade layout, Boss scoring is wrong, and the challenging stage counts escaped enemies as hits. It reads like a Galaga outline whose parts were never run together.
